summary.description: One-paragraph human-readable summary of the overall proposed change, for a network engineer reviewing it in Work Center.

current_state.description: JSON object of the RAW tool output you actually received from pyats_device_health / pyats_show_running_config / pyats_get_neighbors / pyats_learn_feature calls on R1, R2, SW1, SW2 -- not your own paraphrase of it. Keyed by device name.

devices.description: JSON object keyed by exactly R1, R2, SW1, SW2. Each value is an object with "config_commands" (array of CLI config-mode lines, no 'configure terminal' or 'end') and "reasoning" (string explaining why, referencing the actual current_state).
